author: Tobias Ellinghaus
name: delete_long_tags
description: Automatically deletes all tags longer than a user-configured length each time darktable starts.
description-extensive: This tool cleans up your keyword tags by removing any that are longer than a length you choose in the preferences. It runs automatically every time you start darktable, helping keep unwieldy or accidental long tags out of your library. No extra software is needed.
